description:
Download the correspondence table of a document redacted with mode "pseudonymize": one CSV row per tag (placeholder, the user's rename, category, original text), so the names can be restored later.

Only for pseudonymized documents with status "redacted"; a redact-mode document has no table. The table re-identifies the document: keep it with the user and never send it alongside the redacted PDF. It is written to a file on this machine. Never open or read that file: to put the names back into something you wrote, pass its path to restore_names.

document_id.description: The document id, from the documents list of redact_pdf or get_job_status.

output_path.description: Where to write the correspondence CSV on this machine. Defaults to "<document_id>-correspondence.csv" in the working directory. Never overwrites an existing file.

name: download_correspondence
title: Download the tag -> original table of a pseudonymized document
